I had Top Tech Electric move my electrical panel, which was located in the master closet, to outside that wall to have an exterior breaker panel.  They did a great job with the installation.  Everything looks and works great.  They also installed a whole home surge protector.  They replaced my bathroom and kitchen outlets with GFCI outlets as well as installed my fire alarms.  I recently had them come back for another job where I needed two new wires run from the panel to the remodeled bathroom

I recently had a brand-new electrical panel installed in my home, and I couldn’t be more impressed with the level of service and craftsmanship. From the moment the electrician arrived, it was clear I was working with a true professional. They took the time to inspect the existing setup, explain what needed to be upgraded, and walk me through the entire process in a way that was easy to understand.

During the installation, they worked efficiently and safely, double-checking every connection and

Tyler and his partner were amazing! I initially just wanted a quote for a Tesla wall charger or adapter  but their prices were very reasonable and they made time to put it in right then. So happy will definitely be using this company again for any future service.

Absolutely 5-star service! My fuse plug burned out and I was without power in half the house.  They came out the same day, diagnosed the issue quickly, replaced the burnt fuse plug, and checked the rest of the panel to make sure everything was safe. Super professional, thorough, friendly, and explained everything clearly. Great customer service from start to finish. Highly recommend

Update 3 weeks after installation:
Rey & Hector did a sub-par job installing my electric panel and the price would have been reasonable if not for:
The bathroom heater fans were not labeled and one of them was not hooked up to the breaker panel. 5 breakers total had to be relabeled.
Alex came out for the final inspection and spent some time tracking the breakers that were labeled incorrectly, but he did not investigate the electrical issue with the bathroom heater fan not being hooked up or trac

Grant Baker did an amazing job.  He was thorough in explaining the steps they were going to take to solve my plumbing issue.  He was friendly, courteous,  and very knowledgeable.   He won me over for my next plumbing and electrical need.   Highly recommend.

I had a great experience with Johnathan Perry from opTech Electric & Plumbing. He came out to diagnose my tankless water heater and was extremely thorough throughout the process. He took the time to explain what he was checking, what he found, and made sure I fully understood the issue before recommending any next steps. His professionalism, attention to detail, and clear communication really stood out. I’d definitely trust him again for any future plumbing work.
Very pleased with the help of Marco. Was concerned about my electrical box being up to code on purchase of new home. Marco not only was professional but caring and kind to my needs!!

Rey vargas was a very good electrician!! He was able to explain everything and walk us through what happened. Very professional and kind. If I use this service again I will definitely ask specifically for Rey Vargas!! He was able to resolve the issue in a timely manner aswell!!

Ray was very polite, respectful and professional during his visit.  He completed the job and provided a free inspection to address any other potentially hazardous situations.  He is very knowledgeable in his expertise, and I really appreciated all the information without any pressure to commit to additional work.  We will definitely be using Top Tech again for our electrical needs!

We had a blockage very deep within the plumbing. Ian was incredibly thorough and recommended getting a camera service throughout the whole property. We likely could have gotten it out with a longer snake but was very happy with how much we were able to see. Cornel and Ian were intentional and walked through everything. It was good to see the camera footage and they noted some areas to be aware of for potential future blockages. I am so glad I went with TopTech, We will be customers for life. So

Blake and Hector were really so great to work with. I had an emergent situation and reached out through Thumbtack and got a response same day. They were able to get out and start working day of and to my surprise got mostly everything finished by the middle of the next day. It sucked having to have such an expensive repair but Blake took his time to really explain everything and make it make sense and Hector called during their work to continue to keep me updated. Very happy and impressed with t

I had a good experience with TopTech.  My service tech was James, he was punctual, communicative, and got the job done quickly.  I only did a drain cleaning and it was $99 after the coupon.  Other places quoted me 300+ so all around I'm happy with my service.  Will definitely use this company again if I have any other electrical or plumbing issues.
Rey Vargas was awesome! He was able to get out to my property within an hour of calling. He was thorough and took the time to explain everything to me. Highly recommend Top Tech Electric!

Top Tech was a available when I needed them and the technician Marco arrived as promised ready to help with our electrical issue.  He was extremely professional as he listened to us explain the problem.  He gave us a few quotes based on what we may be experiencing.  As he identified the culprit and made the updates needed he made sure to keep us on the most cost effective plan.  I was very impressed by Marco's work ethic and the speed at which he operated.  He made this a 5 star experience for u

I highly recommend this company. It’s easy to make an appointment on the phone. The lady who picked up the phone was very nice and friendly. After appointment, they have text and email message to confirm the appointment and showed the technician’s info and photo. I have to say the technician Blake Lacey did a great job. He is very knowledgeable and professional. Good and easy communications with him. He is the electrician I highly recommended in FW.

I had Blake from Top Tech Electric come by and check out my garbage disposal. He did an excellent job in informing all the issues I had with my house and gave me a very fair quote on what needed to be repaired. I enjoyed how he prioritized my safety and would 100% recommended him. Thank You Blake!

Rey vargas is really good and he provided the best service. He also immediately identified the issue related to ethernet port issue beside electricity issues related to GFCI and solve the issue, he is the best and would recommend to any one looking for the best service. THANKS AGAIN Rey!

We had a couple of bumps at the start, but the way the owner handled it was outstanding. He personally called us twice to make sure everything was fully taken care of and that we were happy. That kind of dedication and customer care is rare these days, and it honestly turned the whole experience around for us. We couldn’t be more grateful and truly appreciate how much they value their customers.

Scheduling with Top Tech was pleasant and easy. Blake arrived exactly when he said he would. He was very patient listening to my concerns and double checked the list my inspector gave me to ensure we covered everything. He was also very kind and upfront about all pricing and safety concerns. Definitely recommend!

Marco was amazing. I found this company on Good Contractors List and called them for a 2nd estimate and they saved me thousands of dollars on an electrical panel replacement that my insurance would not cover. I highly recommend this company.

Technician Marco was very courteous and professional, walked me through all my options and did a great job installing our new ceiling fan. The company was very responsive on Thumbtack and the job was booked in just a couple of hours. Would use them again!

For me having someone I can trust is most important. Because lies are certainly more costly. Ian was courteous, respectful and trustworthy. Combining that with great prices and excellent customer service I'd welcome again should the need arise.

Very happy with the service. Blake was very friendly and knowledgeable. He was upfront about potential issues that would make the job more difficult or impossible to complete. I was fine with all of that. He was able to do the work in a way that I’m very happy with. I will definitely use Top Tech again.

My hardwired smoke alarm system was beeping on and off for two days and I was unable to address it successfully. I called TopTech and my after hours call was responded to quickly. I was given an appt the next day which was very much appreciated. Blake arrived and reviewed my issue with me.  He explained his process to troubleshoot the issue and we discussed the options. I decided to have the entire system replaced due to the erratic performance and the age of the units.  Blake quickly completely

Johnathan was outstanding! He showed up quickly, found the main line issue right away, and cleared it efficiently. He explained everything clearly and made sure the problem was fully fixed before leaving. Professional, honest, and extremely knowledgeable — highly recommend asking for Johnathan if you want the job done right the first time!
Had s great experience with Rey and his colleague replacing my hard wired smoke detector. Very friendly and knowledgeable. I 100% recommend!

Blake did a great job for us!  He showed up and was extremely professional!  He was very clear on how he was going to do the work, gave me a price, and than completed the work.  He introduced himself to everyone in my family which I thought was a nice touch.  The work done looked far superior to what I was expecting!  I would highly recommend him!

The plumbers and electricians were thoroughly professional, easy to communicate with, and did a good job of water heater replacement. They used hoses and fittings that were better than what I have had previously. And the new heater is a good commercial grade unit. They installed a circuit breaker box near the heater and an automatic shut off mechanism to bring imy installation up to code compliance for the first time in 47 years! The city inspector quickly inspected and passed it.

TopTech came within a day of requesting a quote, and even installed that same day within a few hours. Reasonable prices and great service. Blake was also extremely thorough in explaining the process and ensuring I was comfortable. I would recommend to everyone.

Grant Baker and Tony were the man of the hour we needed to fix the leak in our garbage disposable. They did an amazing job. They were friendly, courteous, and very knowledgeable. Highly recommend them. Appreciate the service provided

Very fast and efficient. They were both fantastic and professional to deal with. I needed two dimmers installed and I had a few issues with other rooms lights not working properly. They fixed the issues at a very reasonable cost

TopTech sent Mr. James Allen out today to repair a major wall leak in my home stemming from my outdoor wall spigot. Water had flooded inside the bricks and walls of my home soaking my bathroom floors, master closet and Guest Room.

James immediately assessed the concern and with confidence knew the issue likely lied within the spigot pipe and could be handled from the outside without inside demo needed. Fingers crossed right!?

Sure enough he swapped the faucet/spigot out and tested everything w

Johnathan was amazing, very informative, fixed the issue and helped with another service that we needed as well without upselling. He was fantastic and we will use TopTech for any plumbing needs we have in the future specifically because he was so great. Fantastic asset to the company!

Johnathan did a great job! He found my sewer, clean out, ran a camera to make sure it was clear all the way out to the street and even capped it off for me. Very well spoken, very polite and knowledgeable.
Rey Vargas was quick and efficient at upgrading my dryer outlet from a 3-prong and a 4-prong with new wire!

Rey was promoted and very professional. He performed an electrical inspection for my clients and gave us concise information in a format that was easily explainable. Rey’s customer service was outstanding. Every interaction was easy and seamless.

Marco with Top Tech was incredibly thorough, kind, patient, and understanding. He took the time to go through every detail in our older home, making sure safety was the top priority while also ensuring we’d meet inspection standards. His depth of knowledge and years of experience were clear from the start, and he didn’t miss a thing. Even though we’re still exploring our options, it’s hard to imagine anyone competing with the level of care, thoroughness, and expertise Marco brought to the table.

Had a GFCI go bad and the pantry ballast also went out. Tyler and his partner came over within one hour to quickly assess the issue and fixed the GFCI. The ballast was a special part order only so he offered an alternate solution. Work was clean, professional, and efficient. Thank you Tyler! Will recommend.

Two words. Rey. Vargas. He came to my house, fixed my problem instantly, was affordable, and then jetted off to save someone else’s evening. 10/10 would use TopTech again. Do yourself a favor and choose them.

First time using TopTech Electric. They were able to come out within 24 hours of service request even though it was non-emergent. The electrician (Blake) was polite, patient, and did a very thorough job, correcting items from a previous electrician along the way. I will definitely use TopTech again.

Johnathan replaced a part that was leaking under the sink. He was very informative, friendly, helpful, worked very quickly, and cool to talk to. He fixed the aink part that caused the bottom of the sink to completely leak. I highly recommend hlm and TopTech Electric & Plumbing.

James was awesome! He came out fast, figured out the clogged drain issue right away, and had it fixed in no time. Super friendly, professional, and didn’t try to upsell anything Definitely my go to from now on for any plumbing problems!

Marco took time and thoroughly explained what was potentially causing the issue and also the solutions. He answered all my questions and made me feel good about the work we agreed to. Fair pricing and efficient work, and left a quote for another project. Highly recommend Marco and Top Tech Electric
Ray arrived on time and completed installing our doorbell in a timely fashion. We’re very satisfied with his work!

After an initial hiccup with service area, TopTech was able to send out an estimator and complete rewiring of several rooms the next morning. Unfortunately the initial contractor/installer really wired lights and outlets wrong and set up potential fire hazards. TopTech was able to resolve our problem and improve the wiring in the rooms to be to code and safer giving us piece of mind.

Prompt service but the technician was CONSTANTLY trying to upsell me things I suspected I did not need with sky-high quotes. Got a two more opinions afterwards and got confirmed this. I was promptly scheduled and served but the experience did not feel good.

I had a great experience working with Blake. He was knowledgeable, patient, and took the time to make sure I got exactly what I needed. He explained the differences between products clearly and made sure I understood what would work best for my project.

I needed some 240 outlets added in my garage. Tyler came out looked over what was needed and gave me the quote. I reviewed the quote and after having the quote explained found it was fair. He then started the work and was able to complete it the same morning. Work looks good, and was shown to work. I am happy.
